"""Shared string helpers. Used by billing, imports and reports."""


def split_date(text):
    """Split supported import dates into year, month and day strings.

    Accept ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), slash-separated (YYYY/MM/DD), and European
    day-first dotted (DD.MM.YYYY) dates.
    """
    text = text.strip()
    if "." in text:
        day, month, year = text.split(".")
        return year, month, day

    separator = "/" if "/" in text else "-"
    first, month, last = text.split(separator)
    if separator == "/" or len(first) == 4:
        return first, month, last
    # Keep day-first inputs unambiguous if encountered with another separator.
    return last, month, first
